title: Ten Sacks of Wet Cherry
subtitle: 50 words · one story
paragraphs: The storm had come overnight, and by six the whole plantation smelled of wet earth and split cherries. The drying shed had lost half its roof, and what remained was a shell of blackened timber open to a tin-coloured sky. Ines counted the sacks beneath the gap twice while water accumulated in the gutters, and the grief she felt was oddly practical, the grief of a woman adding up a bill. Pickers were spreading the wet beans across the lawn in long grey lines, and the sight made her exclaim something short in her own language. The precious top grade was gone and the loss was immense, yet the distinct thought she held was that most of the crop still lay dry upstairs.

The cooperative met at eight above the weighing station, with the annual accounts still pinned to the wall from spring. Article nine of the constitution allowed an emergency session only with two thirds of the members present, so Sena read the clause and waited, which was her particular kind of wisdom. There was a brief conflict about whether the ruined sacks should be sold cheaply or written off, and a young member argued with such determination that an older one called the morning a drama. They agreed that Sena, as the cooperative's representative, would submit a claim to the insurer before noon, and the occasion felt less like a meeting than a family deciding how to bury something.

In the packing room the work was slower and more exact. Emre backed the van to the loading door while Ines measured a liter of diesel into the old generator and then spent twenty minutes leaning over its exhaust with a spanner, because the shop that sold auto parts had closed for the season. They had to modify the intake to push adequate air through the lower tray, and selecting which sacks to open first was a matter of density rather than weight. When she pinched a seam to test it the thread gave way, and she wrote the supplier's name on her wrist so she would not forget to complain. On the bench lay the new retail pack, its calorie figure still uncorrected.

The road climbed for eleven kilometres before it entered the tunnel, and Emre drove with the window down because the heater had died. On the motorway two lorries tried to overtake him on a bend where the barrier had been replaced by plastic cones, and he let them go rather than argue about territory. The cargo was worth more than the van, so he watched the temperature gauge the way a cat watches a door. Halfway through the tunnel the gauge plunged, and the assumption that the fault was electrical proved wrong, as assumptions usually do. He pulled onto the verge to investigate, while the cooperative tracked the van on a map and telephoned every ten minutes to ask whether the shipment would reach the port.

At the port the clerk said the photograph on the new pack belonged to somebody else, which made the print run a copyright problem. Ines, a lover of clean paperwork since she was nineteen, took the news with the calm of someone who had never counted on recognition. The cooperative could not afford a second print run out of ordinary revenue, yet the potential was there, for the pack resembled nothing else on the shelf. They agreed to pay the photographer and add an additional line of credit, because integrity was the one thing that could not be bought back. She allowed herself a short farewell to the shed, and by evening she was proficient enough at the new paperwork to teach it to Emre.
translations: 暴雨是连夜来的，六点不到，整座种植园就闻得到湿土和裂开的咖啡果的味道。晾晒棚塌了半边屋顶，剩下的是个焦黑木头的空壳，敞着口对着铁皮色的天。伊内斯把棚下那几排麻袋数了两遍，檐沟里的水也一点点积起来；她心里的悲痛出奇地实际，就像一个人对着账单的那种难过。工人们正把湿豆子摊到草坪上，一长溜灰线；她看见这景象，用自己的话短促地喊了一声。特级品没了，损失很大，可她攥住的念头很清晰：大半的收成还干着，在楼上仓里。

合作社八点在过磅站楼上开会，春天的年度账目还钉在墙上。章程第九条规定，紧急会议须有三分之二成员到场才能开，于是塞娜把这一条念出来，然后等着——那是她特有的那种明智。有人起了场短暂的争执：毁掉的豆子该贱卖，还是干脆报损；一位年轻成员说得那样有决心，把年长的那位逗笑了，说这一早上真是一出戏。最后大家商定由塞娜作合作社的代表，中午前把索赔提交给保险公司；这场集会不像开会，更像一家人商量着怎么把什么东西埋掉。
包装间的活儿更慢，也更讲究。埃姆雷把厢式货车倒到装货口，伊内斯量了一升柴油灌进那台老发电机，随后趴在它的排气管边上拧了二十分钟扳手，因为卖汽车配件的那家铺子这一季关了门。他们得改装进风口，好让足够的风量穿过下层托盘；先开哪几袋，与其说是重量，不如说是密度问题。她捏住一条缝试了试，线就崩了，于是把供货商的名字写在手腕上，免得忘了投诉。台子上搁着新的零售包装，上面那个卡路里数字还没改对。
往北的路爬了十一公里才进隧道，埃姆雷开着窗，因为暖气坏了。高速上两辆卡车想在一个弯道超他，那儿的护栏换成了一排塑料锥筒；他让了，懒得为一块地盘去争。后头的货比这辆车还值钱，所以他盯着温度表，像猫盯着门。进隧道走到一半，表针骤降，“毛病出在电路”这个假设被证明是错的——假设通常都是错的。他把车停到路肩去排查；合作社在地图上追踪这辆车，每十分钟打一次电话，问这批货还能不能赶上码头。

到了港口，买方的办事员说新包装上那张照片是别人的，整批印刷于是成了版权问题。伊内斯从十九岁起就是个喜欢单据干净的人，她听到这消息时的那种平静，属于从不怎么指望被人夸奖的人。合作社的日常收入撑不起第二次印刷，可潜力就在那儿：这个包装跟货架上任何一件都不像。他们商定付钱给摄影师，在报告里多列一笔额外授信，因为诚信是唯一买不回来的东西。她允许自己对那座塌了的棚子说了句简短的告别；到晚上，她已经熟练到能把新单据的规矩教给埃姆雷。

sense_map.calorie: n. 卡路里（食品标签上的热量数值）
sense_map.precious: adj. 珍贵的（指等级最高的那批豆子）
sense_map.representative: n. 代表（代表合作社出面的人）
sense_map.lover: n. 爱好者（a lover of clean paperwork）
sense_map.auto: n. 汽车（用于 auto parts 汽车配件）
sense_map.drama: n. 戏剧性场面、小题大做的戏
sense_map.assumption: n. 假设、想当然的判断
sense_map.integrity: n. 诚信、正直（不可收买的品格）
sense_map.cargo: n. 货物（车船上装载的）

proficient: proficient enough at the new paperwork
van: backed the van to the loading door
occasion: the occasion felt less like a meeting
submit: submit a claim to the insurer
resemble: resembled nothing else on the shelf
assumption: the assumption that the fault was electrical
select: selecting which sacks to open first
shipment: whether the shipment would reach the port
track: tracked the van on a map

the precious top grade.cn: 特级品、最高等级的那批货
the precious top grade.usage: grade 指按品质分的等级，top grade 直接作定语修饰货物，不加 of。

her particular kind of wisdom.usage: kind of 后接不可数抽象名词；particular 强调“独有”，比 special 书面。

a brief conflict about.usage: conflict 与 about/over 连用引出争执内容，brief 一类词限定时长。

a lover of clean paperwork.cn: 喜欢单据干干净净的人
a lover of clean paperwork.usage: a lover of + 名词表“爱好者”，比 fan 正式，不含恋爱义。

a matter of density.usage: a matter of + 名词表“取决于……的事”，常把争论归到单一因素。

adequate air.usage: adequate 强调“刚够用”，比 enough 正式，多修饰不可数名词。

a copyright problem.usage: copyright 直接作定语，不加 ’s；侵权说 infringe copyright，不说 break。

the gauge plunged.usage: plunge 指突然大幅下落，常与 to/by 连用，比 fall 更有画面感。

the assumption that the fault was electr.usage: assumption 后接同位语从句用 that 不用 whether；搭配 make an assumption。

argue about territory.usage: territory 表“势力范围”时不可数；argue about/over 后接争论对象。

a shell of blackened timber.usage: a shell of + 材料，指建筑毁后剩下的外壳，暗含“里面已空”。

out of ordinary revenue.cn: 从日常收入里出这笔钱
out of ordinary revenue.usage: revenue 指机构总收入，通常不可数；out of 比 from 更强调挤出来。

proficient enough at the new paperwork.usage: proficient at/in + 名词或动名词；程度词 enough 要后置。

integrity was the one thing.usage: integrity 指“不可收买的品格”，不可数，偏原则完整，与 honesty 有别。

tracked the van on a map.usage: track 强调持续跟踪移动目标，常带 on a map；名词指“轨迹”。
